# Now let me get the songs from each playlist and remove the old songs from them.
# I'll also track which songs were removed so I can add them to the new playlist.
removed_songs = set()
for playlist in playlists:
    playlist_id = playlist['playlist_id']
    playlist_title = playlist.get('title', '')
    print(f"\nProcessing playlist: {playlist_title} (ID: {playlist_id})")
    playlist_details = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_token)

    for song in playlist_songs:
        song_id = song['id']
        if song_id in old_song_ids:
            print(f"  Removing song {song_id} ({song_details[song_id]}) from {playlist_title}")
            result = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=song_id, access_token=spotify_token)
            print(f"    Result: {result}")
            removed_songs.add(song_id)
print(f"\nTotal removed songs: {len(removed_songs)}")
print(f"Removed song IDs: {removed_songs}")
